name: reconcile-scan-freshness-guard
body: `solution.component.scan-freshness-guard` —implemented-by→ `reanchor_scan_meta`, `content_key`, `is_fresh`, `recorded_scan`, `cmd_scan`, `rust.apg.git.state.db_recorded_scan`, `rust.apg.splice.seed.tree_authored_identity`, and `rust.apg.artifacts.db.ArtifactDb.refresh_scan_row`. The DB `Scan` row equals the `graph.jsonl` recorded scan; the database's authored digest (`seed_authored_identity` over `db.lbug`) equals the tree's assembled digest (`tree_authored_identity`); a live session short-circuits the database reads; and `refresh_scan_row` moves the DB `Scan` row at the durable write points.
